name: Topre Realforce 108 US
notes: 65-byte report descriptor of the keyboard interface of a real Topre Realforce 108 US, recorded with hid-recorder on Linux: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/libinput/libinput/uploads/3dd4c18f7ac48111d23415fa90293c71/nkro_hid.txt. The source gives the device's name, not its own USB strings, so productString is that name. Other interfaces of the real device are not part of this profile.
